property_summary: For any admissible inputs, after a successful 10-ether fallback call at time t1 the contract requires block.timestamp > pastBlockTime (= t1+1), so a subsequent fallback call at any time t2 <= t1+1 must revert; the mutant removed that requirement and lets the second same/earlier-timeframe call succeed, violating the rule.
change_summary: Remove the requirement that block.timestamp be greater than pastBlockTime, allowing multiple calls in the same timeframe.
